observations: PORTAL BUG WORTH KNOWING: LinkedIn searches using the location string "Bengaluru, Karnataka, India" return zero results, while "India" and "Pune, Maharashtra, India" work normally. Bengaluru roles exist and appear fine under a country-wide search. Any past run that searched Bengaluru directly will have silently under-reported India's largest tech market.

Seniority inflation is the dominant pattern this run. Of 18 new postings, exactly one (Kutumb, SDE II) carries the target title. Most product-company backend roles in India are advertised at Senior or above, which means applying one level up is the norm rather than the exception.

Service and staffing firms dominated raw volume and were filtered out per the recorded deal-breaker: UST, Persistent Systems, GyanSys, Uplers, HireVibe, Zensar, Cognizant, Sopra Steria, Synechron, getinz-people, plus aggregator reposts from Jobgether and Weekday. Roughly half of all backend results were in this category.
The equal-weighting change continues to pay: Adyen and Kutumb are pure backend roles with no AI content and rank among the strongest here, while Nightfall AI and Experian hit both tracks at once.
